scientific_integrity: Derivation is analytic from the triangular matrix-unit spectrum; finite exact-rational and direct superoperator checks independently corroborate sample cases, without proving infinite-size assertions.
scientific_limitations: Only generic local exact identifiability in a homogeneous diagonal-Hamiltonian qubit model, with multiplicities kept; tie ratios, statistical noise, and global inverse-regression identifiability are not covered.
title: Exact local spectral-recovery budget and its binomial-to-Gaussian crossover for damped qubits
